triggers.name: ultimate_history
install: create or replace function "ultimate_record_history"() returns trigger language plpgsql as $history$ declare source jsonb := case when tg_op = 'DELETE' then to_jsonb(old) else to_jsonb(new) end; prior jsonb := case when tg_op = 'INSERT' then null else to_jsonb(old) end; ignored text[] := tg_argv[3]::text[]; digits text[] := coalesce(tg_argv[4], '{}')::text[]; instants text[] := coalesce(tg_argv[5], '{}')::text[]; k text; begin if tg_op = 'UPDATE' and (prior - ignored) = (source - ignored) then return null; end if; foreach k in array digits loop if jsonb_typeof(source -> k) = 'number' then source := jsonb_set(source, array[k], coalesce(to_jsonb(source ->> k), source -> k)); end if; if jsonb_typeof(prior -> k) = 'number' then prior := jsonb_set(prior, array[k], coalesce(to_jsonb(prior ->> k), prior -> k)); end if; end loop; foreach k in array instants loop if jsonb_typeof(source -> k) = 'string' then source := jsonb_set(source, array[k], coalesce(to_jsonb(to_char((source ->> k)::timestamptz at time zone 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.MS"Z"')), source -> k)); end if; if jsonb_typeof(prior -> k) = 'string' then prior := jsonb_set(prior, array[k], coalesce(to_jsonb(to_char((prior ->> k)::timestamptz at time zone 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.MS"Z"')), prior -> k)); end if; end loop; execute format('insert into %I select * from jsonb_populate_record(null::%I, $1)', tg_argv[0], tg_argv[0]) using jsonb_build_object('id', gen_random_uuid(), 'row_id', source ->> tg_argv[1], 'op', lower(tg_op), 'at', now(), 'actor_id', nullif(current_setting('x.actor', true), ''), 'request_id', nullif(current_setting('x.request', true), ''), 'before', prior, 'after', case when tg_op = 'DELETE' then null else source end) || case when tg_argv[2] = '' then '{}'::jsonb else jsonb_build_object(tg_argv[2], source -> tg_argv[2]) end; return null; end; $history$;

create trigger "ultimate_history" after insert or update or delete on "posts" for each row execute function "ultimate_record_history"('posts_history', 'id', 'org_id', '{"like_count","updated_at"}', '{}', '{"published_at","created_at","updated_at"}');

triggers.name: ultimate_history_guard
install: create or replace function "ultimate_guard_history"() returns trigger language plpgsql as $history_guard$ begin if tg_op = 'DELETE' and current_setting('x.purge', true) = tg_table_name then return old; end if; raise exception 'X_ENTITY_APPEND_ONLY: % on %.% is refused, the table is history', tg_op, tg_table_schema, tg_table_name using errcode = '23001', hint = 'history is written by its trigger and removed only by purge({ entities: ''declared'' })'; end; $history_guard$;
create trigger "ultimate_history_guard" before update or delete on "posts_history" for each row execute function "ultimate_guard_history"();

triggers.name: ultimate_count_9f9b3faf
install: create or replace function "ultimate_count_9f9b3faf"() returns trigger language plpgsql as $counter$ begin if tg_op <> 'INSERT' and old."run_id" is not null then update "runs" set "event_count" = "event_count" - 1 where "id" = old."run_id"; end if; if tg_op <> 'DELETE' and new."run_id" is not null then update "runs" set "event_count" = "event_count" + 1 where "id" = new."run_id"; end if; return null; end; $counter$;
create trigger "ultimate_count_9f9b3faf" after insert or delete or update of "run_id" on "run_events" for each row execute function "ultimate_count_9f9b3faf"();

views.name: post_like_totals
create: create materialized view "post_like_totals" as select org_id, post_id, count(*)::integer as likes from likes group by org_id, post_id;
